top.title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open-source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns
top.summary: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions, threatening the accessibility that makes open-source communities valuable to developers worldwide.

topIndia.title: Israeli AI security startup Bay raises $50 million
topIndia.summary: Bay says it addresses a primary barrier to AI adoption by "allowing autonomous agents to perform business-critical work safely while enterprises retain control and accountability at scale".

events.summary: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare to unify clinical data and automate workflows. Reduce administrative burnout. See how it works.

events.title: OpenAI unveils a 'Control Room' safety feature that shuts down AI agents from going rogue in 35 seconds
events.summary: OpenAI said Control Room will connect every research inference workload, including agentic sampling for model training and evaluation, data processing, and more. It will work together with its misalignment monitoring systems.

events.title: Google Launches Two New TPUs for Enterprise Agentic AI Workloads
events.summary: Google has expanded its eighth-generation Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) portfolio with two new systems, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max.

events.title: Anthropic plans IPO live stream with Dario Amodei, JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon
events.summary: The meeting is part of the marketing effort for Anthropic’s potentially record-breaking IPO. The offering is expected to formally begin marketing as soon as early Tuesday ahead of pricing and the Nasdaq debut of its shares before the US Thanksgiving holiday, Bloomberg has repo…

events.title: Anthropic unveils new Fable, Mythos models as competition heats up ahead of IPO
events.summary: Anthropic on Monday unveiled two new AI models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, as the OpenAI rival looks to strengthen its position in the fast-growing AI market ahead of its planned IPO.

events.title: Apple Intelligence AI service registers with Chinese regulator for use on tablets, laptops
events.summary: The cyberspace regulator in China's Shanghai said on Monday that Apple's generative AI service, Apple Intelligence, has been registered for use on tablets and laptops in China.

events.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits affair amid Chinese spying allegations; board launches probe
events.summary: The AI chipmaker says it has no reason to believe company secrets were compromised, even as US lawmakers seek answers over potential national security risks.

events.title: Google acquires Wyoming data center site from AI infrastructure firm Crusoe
events.summary: Google has acquired Crusoe's data center site in southeast Wyoming, the AI infrastructure developer said on Friday, a day after the Alphabet unit announced a $17-billion investment in the project.
